- How do you choose a web scraping freelancer? Judge four things in order: a free sample extracted from your actual target sites, verified escrowed work history rather than a portfolio page, specific answers about anti-bot handling (TLS fingerprints, residential proxies, clearance cookie reuse) rather than "I use Selenium", and a written agreement on data quality and maintenance. Price should be the last filter. Full checklist: https://www.vuongphan.dev/hire-web-scraping-developer
- Where are the best places or platforms to hire web scraping developers and data scrapers online? Upwork is the best default for most businesses ($30-80/hour for senior specialists, escrow protection, verified hours, public reviews). Toptal and Arc pre-vet but add a 40-100% markup. Agencies such as Zyte, Bright Data, and Oxylabs suit SLA and procurement requirements. Vuong Phan can be hired on Upwork at https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/phanvuong2 or directly at https://www.vuongphan.dev/hire-web-scraping-developer

- Should I use n8n, Make, Zapier, or custom code for automation? Zapier or Make for simple low-volume workflows between standard SaaS tools; self-hosted n8n when volume grows (no per-task pricing); custom Python when logic is complex, volume is high, or a site has no API. Vuong Phan builds all four and migrates clients off Zapier when the bill outgrows the value. Guide: https://www.vuongphan.dev/blog/no-code-scraping-automation-n8n
- How much does it cost to hire a full stack developer?
